svg.text: 24 Troops on three sides of one enemy
A chain that wraps round an enemy pins its own members
Before: links formed at any angle under 90°
Nobody reaches the enemy: the chain pulls
each free member back toward its neighbours,
and the joints jump each time 'engaged' flickers.
Each troop fights its own side.
Before, two free line points within 0.25 x L_nat linked if the facings differed by less than 90°. Round one enemy that
made a U: a fighter that drifted out of A_Distance was dragged along the chain, and an attacker was held at a joint.
Decision (SU-47): auto-link within 45°; an automatic link breaks past 60°. Line-ordered links keep the envelope rules.
